content.about: Lesotho is a mountain kingdom entirely surrounded by South Africa. It has the highest low point of any country. Its people wear woollen blankets and conical hats. Maletsunyane Falls drops nearly 200 m.

standout.text: Lesotho is the only country entirely above 1,000 m in elevation.

didYouKnow: Lesotho's lowest point is about 1,400 m.
The Basotho hat is a symbol.
It is one of only three countries entirely surrounded by another.
